name: SSL Native Bus Compressor 2
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: values are 0-1 positions, read through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

The display has no units: Threshold and Makeup are dB, Attack is ms (scale 0.001 makes it seconds), Release is seconds. AUTO release carries as auto. The top ratio, X, is an SSL-only setting and isn't carried.
Mix Lock, GroupSense, side-chain and oversampling come back as you left them.
